---
title: "check-def-wiktionary.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check that flags a definition div
whose first bolded defined term is not linked to its Wiktionary entry.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-11-06) is that the reader sees
the ordinary meaning of a word before its technical one.
This implements
[gha#1558](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1558),
for the rule in [psw#505](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/psw/issues/505).

The terms are the comma-separated names in the title of a `#def-` div,
ignoring math.
A bolded instance is `**term**`, `**[term](url)**`, or `[**term**](url)`.
The check reports a definition the pull request edits when

- the first bolded instance of a title name is not a link to `en.wiktionary.org/wiki/`,
  and Wiktionary has an entry for that name, or
- the definition links a Wiktionary page that does not exist.

Wiktionary page titles are case-sensitive,
so the lower-cased name is tried first and then the name as written.
A multiword technical term or a symbol usually has no entry and is not flagged.
A network failure skips the definition with a warning and never fails the run.
`<!-- wiktionary-link: allow -->` in the definition exempts it.

An untouched definition is never reflagged.
With no base ref the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree;
`whole-tree` measures a corpus.

## Usage

Copy [`examples/check-def-wiktionary.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-def-wiktionary.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `fail` | `false` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every definition, not only a pull request's additions |
| `runs-on` | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |
